meta.name: duplicates
meta.description: The duplicate invoice search's rules (jav/domains/finance/duplicates.py): the families of invoice-like types (a document is only compared with the earlier ones of its own family; a pro forma invoice is its own), the fields that name the invoice number, the supplier's tax number and name, and the values compared to tell a copy from a variant.

changelog.note: 224 (plan G-process-core P3c, DECISIONS 218): moved unchanged from configs/policy.json 1.25.0 (its duplicates section), so a change to the duplicate search no longer changes the shared rule file's fingerprint. Earlier history: the policy.json changelog (1.18.0, 126: the duplicate search).
